system.description:
Evil Eye. Make a Strange Check against the target enemy's CR. On a success it loses its next Attack Action and must make a Fear Check. Ticks the Doom Clock 2 minutes.

The Curse (Flaw). You can't bank Luck, and you can never tick the Doom Clock back.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.91

automation.note: The CR is the target enemy's CR. The book gives no CR for the target's Fear Check, so the Director sets it.
